tasks.objective: Persist an optional category distinct from Other, order moderation oldest-first with canonical reason codes, normalize erasure confirmation, and guarantee a usable recovery code before first anonymous scenario success.
side_effects: local migration files only; no database migration execution against user or production data
evidence_required: tests for reason mapping and ASC order
tasks.stop_condition: All data contracts compile and targeted tests pass, or a schema/runtime incompatibility is recorded for re-plan.

tasks.objective: Create the shared restrained civic Operate vocabulary, replace duplicate sidebar navigation with one compact top bar, and align the raw beta entry/orientation shell.
side_effects: changes the local application shell and beta entry rendering
tasks.stop_condition: Shared shell and orientation compile without changing unrelated auth/dialog primitives.

tasks.objective: Replace the mandatory category gate with one accessible body-first form using minimal TipTap, optional category, alias preview, consent-gated local copy, durable inline errors, and unambiguous submission failure.
expected_outputs: redirect compatibility for old category URLs
tasks.stop_condition: Critical form passes targeted tests and browser submit path reaches confirmation.

tasks.objective: Align confirmation, recovery, My scenarios, public reading, sensitive content, moderation and erasure surfaces with the confirmed language and civic Operate/Read hierarchy.
side_effects: changes local participant and moderator UI behavior; no external communication
evidence_required: email path hidden in beta recovery
tasks.stop_condition: All scoped follow-up surfaces compile and their targeted tests pass.

tasks.objective: Replace copy-bound or fake tests with rendered contract tests, add an active critical-flow browser test where feasible, and align in-scope product/design documentation without overwriting unrelated README work.
side_effects: test fixtures may use disposable local database state only
evidence_required: tests exercise implementation rather than copied constants
tasks.stop_condition: Changed behavior has current automated coverage and docs no longer contradict the beta UI.

tasks.objective: Run formatting/lint, typecheck, focused and full tests, production build, scope diff review and the single required Impeccable detector pass.
evidence_required: command, exit status and relevant output for each check
tasks.stop_condition: All introduced failures resolved; unrelated or unavailable checks classified.

tasks.objective: Obtain independent adversarial review of security, accessibility, UX intent, data migration and test coverage, then validate each finding locally.
tasks.stop_condition: Every material finding is confirmed or rejected with evidence.

tasks.objective: Fix confirmed findings and rerun every invalidated check.
write_set: only files implicated by confirmed findings
tasks.stop_condition: No confirmed material finding remains unresolved.

tasks.objective: Exercise the real local critical flow and capture bounded desktop/mobile, light/dark, keyboard and zoom evidence.
evidence_required: screenshots and action outcomes tied to acceptance criteria
tasks.stop_condition: Critical local flow is proven or environment blockers are precisely documented.
